<DIV><P style='font:13.5pt Times New Roman;margin-top:3pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt'><A name=Appointment_Letter_for_Independent_Regis /><B>Appointment Letter for Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:14pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt'><B>Alexander Tech</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:2.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Arial;margin:0;margin-left:17.85pt'><B>Marhc 07, 2026</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>March 9th, 2026</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt'><B>PG Accountants LLC</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Georgia;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>1325, Main Street, Suite 401,</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Georgia;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>Katy TX 77494</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Georgia;margin-top:1.55pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>Re: Appointment as Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>Dear Partners:</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:6.65pt'>On behalf of <B>Alexander Tech Corp. </B>(the <B>Company</B>), the Board of Directors (the <B>Board</B>) is pleased to confirm the appointment of <B>PG Accountants LLC </B>(&#8220;<B>PG</B>&#8221;) as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm, effective <B>February 27, 2026</B>, to perform audit and related services for the fiscal year ending <B>April 30, 2026</B>, and thereafter until such time as the Board determines otherwise.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=1._Scope_of_Engagement /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>1.</KBD><B>Scope of Engagement</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.25pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:1.9pt'>PG will perform the annual audit of the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ending April 30, 2026, and will provide an opinion thereon in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) rules. PG will also provide such other audit, review, attestation, and advisory services as the Company and PG may agree in writing from time to time.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=2._Authority_and_Access /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>2.</KBD><B>Authority and Access</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:6.65pt'>The Company will provide PG with full access to all books, records, personnel, and other information reasonably necessary for PG to perform its engagement. The Company will cooperate with PG and will make available management and other personnel as reasonably requested.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.25pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=3._Independence_and_Professional_Standar /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>3.</KBD><B>Independence and Professional Standards</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>PG represents that it is independent of the Company within the meaning of applicable professional standards and SEC rules. PG will comply with all applicable professional standards, laws, and regulations in performing the engagement.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:30pt'><A name=4._Engagement_Terms_and_Fees /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>4.</KBD><B>Engagement Terms and Fees</B>&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:3pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:6.65pt'>Fees for services will be agreed upon in a separate engagement letter and will be reasonable and customary for the scope of services provided. The Company will reimburse PG for reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred in connection with the engagement.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=5._Deliverables_and_Timing /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>5.</KBD><B>Deliverables and Timing</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt'>PG will deliver an audit report and any required communications to the Board, the Audit Committee (if constituted), and management in accordance with applicable standards and SEC filing deadlines. PG will coordinate timing with the Company to permit timely filing of required reports.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=6._Communications_and_Reporting /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>6.</KBD><B>Communications and Reporting</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:6.65pt'>PG will communicate with the Board and management regarding audit scope, significant findings, internal control matters, and any other matters required by professional standards or SEC rules. PG will provide any required letters, consents, or other documentation necessary for SEC filings.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:30pt'><A name=7._Termination /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>7.</KBD><B>Termination</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt;margin-right:2.7pt'>This appointment may be terminated by either party upon written notice. In the event of termination, the Company will pay PG for services performed and expenses incurred through the effective date of termination.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=8._Regulatory_Filings /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>8.</KBD><B>Regulatory Filings</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>The Company is authorized to file any notices or reports required by the SEC or other regulators to reflect PG&#8217;s appointment and any related matters, and to provide PG with copies of such filings.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.25pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:30pt'><A name=9._Governing_Law /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-12pt'>9.</KBD><B>Governing Law</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.15pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>This appointment letter will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><A name=10._Acceptance /><KBD style='position:absolute;font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-left:-18pt'>10.</KBD><B>Acceptance</B>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>Please confirm your acceptance of this appointment and the terms set forth above by signing and returning a copy of this letter. Upon receipt of your acceptance, the Company will take any corporate actions necessary to formalize the engagement and will provide PG with such additional documentation as PG may reasonably request.</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.05pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:18pt'>We appreciate your acceptance of this engagement and look forward to working with you. Sincerely,</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>

<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>Paras Shah</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'>Sole Director, Principal Executive Officer, Principal Financial Officer</P>

<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>Accepted and Agreed:</B></P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0.2pt;margin-bottom:0pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:12pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:18pt'><B>PG Accountants LLC</B></P>
